dialogues.speaker: Shikun
dialogues.text: Greetings, my guest! Our village is just a few more steps to the north if you follow this path!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Distinguished guests?

dialogues.speaker: Shikun
dialogues.text: Every visitor is a guest, and we will do our best to host them.

dialogues.speaker: Shikun
dialogues.text: There's an extraordinary aura of elegance about you. You might bring us good fortune, I reckon, and that makes you an important guest indeed!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Shikun
dialogues.text: Tradition dictates that those who're in good health must help their neighbors once they're done with their own work.

dialogues.speaker: Shikun
dialogues.text: Uncle Luo, the village elder, arranges our shifts. Several of us are in the south, and several more in the north, so we're always prepared.

dialogues.speaker: Shikun
dialogues.text: If anyone needs help, they only have to talk to us.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Shikun
dialogues.text: Farewell for now. Come find me anytime you need help.

dialogues.speaker: Shikun
dialogues.text: Once tonight's shift is over, I should be able to get in a few drinks with my brothers...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You even do night shifts!?

dialogues.speaker: Shikun
dialogues.text: Hey, some tea farmers start toiling away at three or four in the morning! A helping hand's always welcome in that pitch darkness!

dialogues.speaker: Shikun
dialogues.text: Someone like me, who isn't busy but has plenty of energy to spare, is the perfect candidate for that sort of night shift. Call me and I'll be there!

dialogues.speaker: Shikun
dialogues.text: The wee hours are great for getting things done. It's so quiet, so you can work away without getting distracted!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You've got lots of brothers then?

dialogues.speaker: Shikun
dialogues.text: Oh no, they're not actually my brothers! We're just a group of pals who work together regularly.

dialogues.speaker: Shikun
dialogues.text: I'm one of the younger ones, so I call them my big brothers!

dialogues.speaker: Shikun
dialogues.text: We often help our neighbors out, and in return, they've dubbed us the "Six Little Dragons of Qiaoying Village."

dialogues.speaker: Shikun
dialogues.text: I'm the fourth oldest, so that makes me "Fourth Dragon"! Haha...

dialogues.speaker: Shikun
dialogues.text: These past two years, Fifth and Sixth have left to work as a bodyguard and a boatman respectively. Third's found a job at Yilong Wharf...

dialogues.speaker: Shikun
dialogues.text: So it's usually just the three of us — First, Second, and little old Fourth — drinking and chatting about our families.

dialogues.speaker: Shikun
dialogues.text: As fulfilling as a hard day's work is, a lazy day's not a bad day either!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have fun then!

dialogues.speaker: Shikun
dialogues.text: Thanks, you too!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So how is the pay calculated?

dialogues.speaker: Shikun
dialogues.text: Nah, it's not, we're way too close to worry about formalities like that!

dialogues.speaker: Shikun
dialogues.text: After we helped them out, the neighbors treated us to dinner and we had a few drinks together! That counts as payment!

dialogues.speaker: Shikun
dialogues.text: Yeah, I even moved a bunch of clothes and books for Deyin a couple of days ago, and he made some killer egg soup!

dialogues.speaker: Shikun
dialogues.text: If you have some time, you should go chat with him and let him tell you stories about Chenyu Vale!
